component.name: Silage
component.summary: An unofficial Silo client for Linux

description.p: Silage is a fullscreen, couch-friendly home-theater app for Silo media servers. It is not affiliated with the Silo project.

ul.li: Direct play at full quality with mpv and hardware decoding
HDR passthrough on HDR-enabled Wayland displays
Choose which copy of a title to play, such as 4K Dolby Vision or 1080p
A sidebar of your libraries, poster rows, detail pages, search and watchlist
Recommendations, calendar, shuffle, profile collections and cast pages
Requests, notification inbox and native desktop notifications
Subtitle search, downloads, AI creation and appearance controls
Autoplay, chapters, draggable seeking and desktop media keys
Per-server remembered sign-in with desktop keyring support
Fully usable with a keyboard or remote, including confirmed Escape-to-quit

description.p: Linux and Windows now share the full desktop feature set. Windows adds a single-file portable EXE with Java and mpv included. Linux adds native media controls and notifications, with per-server remembered sign-in on both platforms.
New browsing, requests, subtitle tools, autoplay, chapters and draggable seeking join fullscreen startup, the Silage icon, a four-second startup animation and keyboard or mouse quit confirmation.
Home's banner is smaller and shrinks to half its height with a smooth animation once you scroll into the rows.
Home's rows no longer scroll over the banner's title and description. Packages declare the display libraries they need.
